chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Mahboub, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Ma'rouf ibn Kharabouz, from Al-Hakam ibn Mustawrid, from Ali ibn al-Husayn (peace be upon him), who said:
Indeed, among the sustenance that Allah has measured out for the people, from what they need, is the sea (atmosphere), which Allah, Mighty and Majestic, created between the sky and the earth.

He said: And Allah has determined in it the flows of the sun, the moon, the stars, and the planets, and has determined all of that upon the orbit. Then He assigned an angel to the orbit, and with him are seventy thousand angels, so they turn the orbit. So when they turn it, the sun, the moon, the stars, and the planets turn with it, and they descend in their stations which Allah, Mighty and Majestic, has determined for them, for their day and their night.

So when the sins of the servants become numerous and Allah, Blessed and High, intends to admonish them with a Sign from His Signs, He orders the angel assigned to the orbit to remove the orbit upon which are the flows of the sun, the moon, the stars, and the planets. So the angel orders those seventy thousand angels to remove it from its flows.

He said: So they remove it, and the sun becomes in that sea which flows in the orbit. He said: So its light is obliterated and its color changes. So when Allah, Mighty and Majestic, intends to magnify the Sign, the sun is obliterated in the sea, according to what Allah loves that His creatures should fear regarding the Sign. He said: And that is during the eclipse of the sun.

He said: And He does similarly with the moon. He said: So when Allah intends to clear it or return it to its flow, He orders the angel assigned to the orbit to return the orbit to its flow. So he returns the orbit, and the sun returns to its flow. He said: So it emerges from the water, and it is dim. He said: And the moon is like that.

He said: Then Ali ibn al-Husayn (peace be upon him) said: Indeed, no one is startled by them nor fears these two Signs except one who is from our Shiites. So when that is so, be startled to Allah, Mighty and Majestic, then return to Him.
ai.seo_question: How do celestial eclipses function as divine signs for repentance in Shia theology?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Kafi presents a unique Shia cosmological view where celestial mechanics are actively managed by angels to serve as divine warnings (ayat) for human sinfulness, specifically linking the dimming of the sun and moon to moral decay. It emphasizes that while general humanity may fear these phenomena, the true believers (Shiites) are instructed to respond with immediate repentance (istitab) rather than panic, highlighting the spiritual significance of cosmic signs in Shia eschatology and theology.

He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘So they remove it and the sun becomes in that sea (atmosphere) in which flows in the orbit’. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘So its light gets obliterated and its colour changes. So if Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic Intends to maximise the Sign, He<sup>azwj</sup> Obliterates the sun in the sea (atmosphere) upon what Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Loves that His<sup>azwj</sup> creatures should fear His<sup>azwj</sup> Signs’. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘So if Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Intends to End it or Return it back to normal, He<sup>azwj</sup> Orders the Angel in charge of the orbit that he should return the orbit back to its normality. So he returns the orbit and the sun goes back to its normality’. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘So he takes it out from the water (fluid) and it is brownish (dim)’. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘And the (matter of) the moon is similar to that’.

So if (these Signs) have happened, so be scared to Allah<sup>a</sup><sup>zwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic, then return (Repent) to Him<sup>azwj</sup>’.
